reallastupdate-desc: Save the last update date by a flesh and blood editor
reallastupdate-apierror-no-real-revision: No real revision was found for "$1"
reallastupdate-apierror-is-redirect: Cannot get real last update for redirect page "$1"
reallastupdate-specialpage-desc: Shows pages with their last human edit timestamps
reallastupdate-namespace-unreadable: You cannot read pages in the selected namespace, so they are not listed.
apiwarn-reallastupdate-cannotread: Real last update data for "$1" was left out: you cannot read that page, or the page it redirects to.
apihelp-query+reallastupdate-summary: Get the revision and time of each page's last edit by a human editor, as opposed to a bot.
apihelp-query+reallastupdate-param-debug: Add debugging information to the result.
apihelp-query+reallastupdate-param-follo: For a redirect, return the data of the page it points to, following up to two redirects.
apihelp-query+reallastupdate-example-1: Get the last human edit of <kbd>Main Page</kbd>.
apihelp-query+reallastupdate-example-2: Get the last human edit of several pages.
apihelp-query+reallastupdate-example-3: Get the last human edit of every page.
apihelp-query+reallastupdate-example-4: Get the last human edit of the page that <kbd>SomeRedirect</kbd> points to.
